title: When Thermal-Margin Control Helps and When It Hurts: Convex Allocation for Multi-Tenant Edge Inference on Raspberry Pi 5
description: Reproducible artifact for a matched-baseline study of convex thermal-margin allocation for multi-tenant edge inference on a Raspberry Pi 5 (Arm Cortex-A76), the subject of a manuscript. Includes the controller, the matched baselines, the raw campaign data and the scripts that regenerate the manuscript's tables and figures. See the README for the current status of each result.
